python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, urllib.error
r=urllib.request.Request('https://statarena-analytics.vercel.app/api/health',headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache'})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as response:
        print(response.status, response.read(8192).decode('utf-8',errors='replace'))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code, error.read(8192).decode('utf-8',errors='replace'))
